g.text: AS-IS: Travel-cost reimbursement â one monthly cycle
Submit general info (Name of payer & period) monthly
Sign the printed form with date on site
Mark attendance per session (x, E = present; U = unexcused)
Collect TN Travel mode (Abo-Karte photo or PKW-Kennzeichen)
Identify PKW cases from memory / request
Log all data in tracking Excel
Check proofs against ticket type & legibility
Rename TN's cloud folder to signal missing docs
Calculate presence days from the list
Default to Deutschlandticket unless other is cheaper
Calculate amount (ticket Ã· workdays Ã presence days)
Write monthly data by pen (amount, dates)
Write "Der/Die TN hat keine unentschuldigten Fehltage." (if applicable)
Print all the proofs together and attach them to the form
Ask Approvers for the latest payment list
Mark as paid in Excel file
Final check by Thorsten or Florian
